clue.text: Dwarf boxer may feel so …

explanation.surface: A short boxer feels a certain way, and the ellipsis carries the thought on into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is a pun: split the word as BASH-FUL, how a boxer feels after a pounding.
explanation.definitionFit: Bashful is the name of one of the seven dwarfs in the Snow White tale.

clue.text: Drone: one who wouldn't give more over competition

clue.text: Part of orchestra I start to retract from early movements

clue.text: Endless nausea, nasty, that is keeping daughter away, most alarmed

parts.note: id est, Latin for that is, written out

explanation.surface: Sickness that won't stop, a nasty state that keeps the daughter away, makes someone very worried.

clue.text: … as evidenced by this musical style?

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins this to 9 across: the answer is its own reflection, reading the same backwards and forwards.

clue.text: This…possibly gives 'eternal, no end to life'?
